title: France And I
author: Lucile at France And I
description: France and I give a voice to foreign expats in France to empower others to make the move. In todays episode Jennifer, an expat for 8 years in France, will give us her insight on moving to France with children and her French entrepreneurial adventure at The Graceful Movement Follow France And I on Facebook for more free ressources and French class offers especialy designed for expats
